title: The Second Sun
changes: Kel Ashar has people now: Sefa the Well-Keeper, Captain Rakhim of the Sand Watch, Zahra who sells potions, and Oren the bladesmith who sells and repairs Act 2 gear.
A new story for Act 2, The Second Sun: 7 quests from Lv 30 to 44. Kel Ashar's spring is sinking. Find out why, from the Dustrider camp to the drowned cisterns of Kharsun and the Veiled Sanctum.
Shatter the Veiled Circle's sun-glass sigils at the oases and read the water-script on Kharsun's sealed cisterns.
The quest arrow now points you to the waygate when your quest is in the other land.
